headline: Nifty Bulls Find Support Near 24,800 As Indian Markets Resume Trading After Holiday Break

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian stock markets reopen today after remaining closed for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday on Tuesday.
Nifty bulls are holding support around 24,800 with analysts recommending a buy-on-dips approach.
US stocks ended lower as hot inflation data and hawkish US Fed remarks renewed rate hike concerns.
India VIX has increased 68% over 47 days and gained 18% over the last three weeks.
whatHappening: Stocks including Bajaj Finance, Tata Motors, Kalyan Jewellers, Cochin Shipyard, and MRF are in focus for today's session.
Individual ownership in NSE-listed companies reached a record 19.5% in Q2FY27.
Sensex and Nifty 50 surged over 6% in the five sessions leading up to the holiday break.
Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) debuted on the NSE with a Rs 200-crore bond listing, making it Bihar's first civic body in the bond market.
summary: Indian stock markets resume trading today following Tuesday's Diwali-Balipratipada holiday. Nifty holds support near 24,800 as analysts suggest a buy-on-dips strategy despite persistent global inflation and rate hike concerns. Stocks in focus include Bajaj Finance, Tata Motors, Kalyan Jewellers, Cochin Shipyard, and MRF.
